description:
Multi use trail, primarily used for mountain biking. Rated as a double black, downhill, singletrack ride. This trail is full of granite slab features and has spectacular views of Mount Currie. Typically ridden North to South. Dog friendly.

Distance 1.1 km | Ascent 11m | Descent -152m
directions: Accessible through Lumpy's through a few connecting trails. (50.299820, -122.804370).
title: Tower of Power
